solve:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes, modulo MOD, a combinatorial count for each vertex of a tree rooted at vertex 0 using subtree-size factorials, BFS parent/child relationships, and modular inverse factorials." solve]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> n </REF>: int "Number of vertices in the tree."
        <REF> edge_list </REF>: List[Tuple[int, int]] "List of n-1 undirected edges, each a pair of vertex indices."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> res_list </REF>: List[int] "Result list of length n with the modular combinatorial count for each vertex."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize factorial as a list of n ones; for i from 1 to n-1 inclusive, set factorial[i] = (factorial[i-1] * i) % MOD. RESULT factorial]
            [COMMAND Initialize factorial_inv as a list of n ones; set factorial_inv[-1] = pow(factorial[-1], MOD - 2, MOD); for i from n-2 down to 1 inclusive, set factorial_inv[i] = (factorial_inv[i+1] * (i+1)) % MOD. RESULT factorial_inv]
            [COMMAND Build graph adjacency list g as a list of n empty lists; for each index i from 0 to n-2 inclusive, unpack edge_list[i] into a and b, append b to g[a], and append a to g[b]. RESULT g]
            [COMMAND Initialize order as an empty list, parent as [-1]*n with parent[0]=0, children as n empty lists, and queue as deque([0]); while queue is non-empty, pop p from the left, append p to order, and for each neighbor q in g[p], if parent[q] == -1, set parent[q]=p, append q to children[p], and append q to queue. RESULT order, parent, children]
            [COMMAND Initialize count_children_res to [-1]*n; for x in reversed order, if children[x] is empty set count_children_res[x]=0; otherwise set total to the sum of count_children_res[y] over child y in children[x], set count_children_res[x] = len(children[x]) + total. RESULT count_children_res]
            [COMMAND Initialize assign_children_res to [-1]*n; for x in reversed order, if children[x] is empty set assign_children_res[x]=1; otherwise set r = factorial[count_children_res[x]], then for each child y in children[x], multiply r by assign_children_res[y] and by factorial_inv[count_children_res[y]+1], reducing modulo MOD after each child, and store r in assign_children_res[x]. RESULT assign_children_res]
            [COMMAND Initialize assign_parents_res to [-1]*n and set assign_parents_res[0]=1; for each x in order[1:], let p = parent[x], compute r = assign_children_res[p] * pow(assign_children_res[x], MOD - 2, MOD) * factorial[count_children_res[x]+1] * factorial_inv[count_children_res[p]] * assign_parents_res[p] * factorial[n - count_children_res[x] - 2] * factorial_inv[n - count_children_res[p] - 1], reduce r modulo MOD, and set assign_parents_res[x] = r. RESULT assign_parents_res]
            [COMMAND Initialize res_list to [0]*n and set res_list[0] = assign_children_res[0]; for i from 1 to n-1 inclusive, set res = factorial[n-1]; for each child j in children[i], multiply res by assign_children_res[j] and by factorial_inv[count_children_res[j]+1], reducing modulo MOD after each child; then multiply res by assign_parents_res[i] and by factorial_inv[n-1-count_children_res[i]], reduce modulo MOD, and set res_list[i] = res. RESULT res_list]
            [COMMAND Return res_list as the final result. RESULT res_list]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
